display_name: Framed listing image: equal white mat, thin oak frame, soft shadow
purpose: The house style for every artwork listing (B-050). The artwork is placed unchanged, so this derivative is not consequential.
measured_from: Owner's framed portrait example, 1024 x 1536 (2026-10-27). Mat and frame ratios are relative to the artwork's displayed width.

canvas.note: The canvas follows the artwork's shape (owner: about 95% of artworks are square, portrait or landscape). Portrait is measured from the owner's example; square and landscape keep its margins.

mat.note: Equal on all four sides (owner, 2026-10-27; v1 copied the example's deeper bottom mat).

texture.note: A straight run of the top bar of a blank oak frame image. The image is a local asset (.commerce-os/assets/oak-frame.png), not committed.
